debt.title: Debts
debt.ask: Do you repay any debt every month?
debt.why: A loan or repayment you make every month. I'll leave room for it in your surplus. Rent can wait for your statement.

chama.title: Chama
chama.ask: Are you in a chama right now?
chama.why: If you contribute, tell me the name and the amount so I don't treat that money as spare.

newChama.title: A new chama
newChama.ask: Would you like to join a chama?
newChama.why: Say yes only if you want one. I'll show it in the app. Saying no changes nothing else.

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin
bitcoin.whyReasons: Pick any that fit. I'm asking so I know how much to explain. Nothing is bought on this step.
bitcoin.askWhere: Where do you buy or hold it?
bitcoin.whyWhere: A name is enough. You don't have to share an amount. Nothing is bought on this step.
bitcoin.whyEver: So I know how much to explain. This step does not buy anything.

goal.title: Ready for
goal.ask: What do you want this money to help you feel ready for?
goal.why: Pick one. A small habit comes later, and you still approve each purchase.

reasons.no_understanding: I don't understand how it works
reasons.capital: It feels like it needs too much money
reasons.regulation: I'm not sure about the rules in Kenya
reasons.returns: I want something that pays back sooner

summary.debtNo: No monthly debt to set aside.
summary.wantsChama: You'd like to join a chama.
summary.wantsChamaNo: You don't want a chama just yet.
summary.wantsChamaSkipped: Joining a chama: skipped for now.
summary.goalSkipped: What you're saving toward: skipped for now.
summary.next: Next I'll ask for your history, on this phone.

finale.title: On this phone
finale.whyDone: Nothing here leaves the phone. Next is your history.
finale.whyReading: One line at a time, from what you just said.
